title: BEST INFINITE IRON CREEPER FARM Minecraft Bedrock 1.21! MCPE/Xbox/PS4/Nintendo Switch/Windows 10
description:
In this video, I will show you how to make the next generation of infinite multi-iron creeper farms using v3 of the new creeper farm, which is now updated to version 3, combined into an iron farm because of huge requests that players had to update multi-type farms. This farm is a beast. In addition to being fast and cheap, it makes it easier to get afk, do multi-farm farming, and work in one place in Minecraft!

If you enjoyed this channel, it will focus on high-performance and simple farms that are beyond levels of bedrock so be sure to turn on the notification to be notified!
